summary_rationale: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS business-quality verdict with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. Unlike acquisition-dependent pharmaceutical peers, Regeneron operates a repeatable, founder-led internal discovery engine (VelociSuite) paired with wholly owned mammalian biologics manufacturing in Rensselaer and Limerick, generating >80% product gross margins and converting 90.6% of FY2025 GAAP net income ($4,505M) into Free Cash Flow ($4,081M) even after expensing $5.85B (40.8% of revenue) in R&D. Operationally, Q3 2026 marked a decisive inflection: total revenue accelerated 36% YoY to $5.12B, Dupixent reached $6.5B in quarterly global net sales (+35% YoY), Eylea HD grew 62% YoY to $699M (~64% of the U.S. retinal franchise), Libtayo reached a $2.2B annualized run rate (+51% YoY), and Q2 2026 full repayment of the Sanofi development balance eliminated the 20% profit-share deduction. With $16.2B in net cash as of Q3 2026, Regeneron self-funds multi-modality pipeline expansion (Lynozyfic, Ordspono, Livsayis, Pasatru, and CIDEB siRNA). Watch items remain legacy 2 mg Eylea biosimilar erosion, Eylea HD prefilled-syringe fill-finish execution after the 2025 Catalent CRL, and building a $10B+ commercial bridge ahead of Dupixent's ~2031 U.S. patent expiration.
